cases.title: Enroll Here Update - Call Drops / Network Instability
cases.findings: ⚠️ CORRECTION: Original analysis blamed maintenance; Shreya confirmed root cause was network instability, NOT maintenance. Customer (Tim) is now asking for clarification: 'So unrelated to maintenance?' Also raising separate issue: calls ending with 200 hangup code in prior incidents. Action needed: Sean should post a correction retracting the maintenance explanation. Need actual EST timestamps from customer's graphs to re-analyze. Need to address the 200 hangup code question.
cases.notes: Sensei-assisted analysis. CRITICAL LESSON: Never attribute customer issues to coincidental events without evidence. Shreya corrected at 21:15 UTC Apr 9 — 'network instability issue'. Customer pushed back strongly ('hope this is a bad joke').
cases.response: Pending correction from Sean retracting the maintenance explanation.

cases.title: SIMs with Signal - No Data Connection (Honest Mobile)
cases.findings: SIMs showing signal but no data connection. Issue isolated to specific PWGs (honest-pwg-eu-prod-*). Moving SIMs to Default PWG restores data immediately; moving back to original PWG drops data again. Affected SIMs in Mexico (Telcel), Albania (One.al), Cyprus (Cyta). Possible PWG blocklist or 3G blocking impact.
cases.notes: VIP customer. Complex investigation. Could be PWG-specific blocklist or 3G sunset impact.
